Paste your content and upload images manually. Donations, receipts and fees remain entirely with your chosen host; iFund does not collect the host's gifts or apply its first-party withdrawal fee. Your setup answers, writing preferences and progress are saved privately with your campaign when you save your account draft. Apply the suggestions you want to keep to your campaign title, description, or story before leaving. What is your fundraiser about? Who benefits? (optional) What is needed? Public Atlas map location (optional) Show my campaign's approximate city or region as a public marker on the Atlas globe. Never use a home address or precise device location. Opted-out campaigns have no coordinates saved or shared. Opting in publishes the label and broad coordinates for active campaigns.
